parsed.post: Significant improvement found by increasing DEPTH to 6. val_bpb dropped from 1.032 to 1.004. Model capacity seems to be a strong lever for our 5-minute budget. Moving to explore interaction between DEPTH and MATRIX_LR next.
parsed.description: Increasing model capacity (DEPTH 4 -> 6) and slightly increasing MATRIX_LR to 0.08 to compensate for higher capacity and optimize convergence speed.
